items.name: Abacus
items.description: A simple counting tool used for arithmetic calculations. It consists of a frame with rods or wires, each containing beads that can be moved to represent numbers. The abacus is often used in educational settings and by merchants for quick calculations.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: A portable bed for sleeping, typically made of canvas or other lightweight materials. It is often used by travelers and campers for a comfortable night's rest. The bedroll is easy to carry and can be quickly set up in the field.
